findings.text: crates/core/src/editor.rs:1096-1115 — the fix's day-change tests have a new-event series case only in the presets check (`repeat_choices`), not a weekly rule's day or an `Ends::On` last day after All day is ticked and the day changed. That is the `before.weekday()` and `Ends::On` branch the fix now reaches for an all-day start. A regression there would pass the tests → add a test that picks the weekly preset or a rule with an end date, ticks All day, changes the day and asserts `rule.days` and `ends` follow.

crates/core/src/editor.rs:525-529 — the closure parses the date before checking `self.all_day`, so the date is parsed twice for every start change when All day is off; the result is the same and the cost is trivial → write `self.all_day.then(...)` first or `self.all_day.then_some(())?`; optional.

crates/core/src/editor.rs:1131-1139 — the "untick All day, time empty → START_TIME_EMPTY" test (the round-2 suggestion) was added and is right. It passes on the old code too, so it guards against regression rather than proving the fix; no action needed.
